fixes.reason: This is not a true table. It is a grid of hazard symbol pictures, each with a one-word caption, under the box heading 'European symbols'. There are no printed column headings, so one column uses the box heading. Rows follow the captions in reading order: four, four, then two. The library grid (T+, F+) came from the symbol images and is wrong.
fixes.evidence: Page 3 image, box 'Safety data sheets', right side: captions Toxic, Very toxic, Harmful, Irritant / Highly flammable, Extremely flammable, Explosive, Dangerous to the environment / Oxidising, Corrosive.
